name: Commentarr
description: Shared, timestamped comments in the player. See what everyone else said at this exact moment.

versions.changelog: New Bubble mode, the default on phones: one comment at a time in a small speech bubble, popping up as you reach its moment. Tap a bubble to open the panel and write your own.

Jellyfin Media Player: closing the sidebar now gives the video the whole window back (it could stay small on displays with scaling), and the video lines up beside the sidebar correctly on scaled displays.
The sidebar is a solid dark panel when it sits beside or below the video (glass only when it floats over the picture).

Works in Jellyfin Media Player and Jellyfin Desktop: these apps play video natively (mpv), so Commentarr now follows their playback through the server and the comments button appears in their player too. Where the app allows it, the sidebar shrinks the video to sit beside it.

Better on phones: the sidebar now makes room for the video (beside it when the phone is sideways, above it when upright), and the overlay is a compact panel tucked into the top corner. The overlay's comment box is a single line until you start typing. The plugin now shows its icon in Jellyfin.

New Comments subtitle track: pick it in any app's subtitle menu, TV apps included, to see comments pinned to moments as subtitles. Admins can turn it off or leave spoilers out of it in the plugin settings. Fix: tapping Spoiler or the time chip no longer clears what you've typed.

Second screen for TV apps: while something plays on your TV, open Jellyfin on your phone and tap the Comments pill. The full comment panel follows the TV to within a fraction of a second, pins your comments to its moment, jumps it to a tapped time, and has Play/Pause.

Spoiler toggle when posting: spoiler comments stay covered until someone taps to read them, everywhere including the live panel. Writers and server admins can mark or unmark a spoiler later. The viewer setting is now Hide ahead, which also covers comments from later episodes.

Comments always land on the title you are watching. The overlay keeps recent moments first, rotates in the best comments from this title and the rest of the show, and steps aside when there is nothing to show. On wide screens the sidebar sits beside the video. Pin to the current moment is now opt-in.
The comments button now sits in the player control row with the other buttons. Overlay mode is a small, always-on panel of the four latest moments (three on a phone) with a one-line composer.
First release: overlay and sidebar modes, pinned moments, replies, likes, spoiler mode, live updates, reports and per-server moderation.
